name: 09-customer-service-rag-context
description: RAG prompt with retrieved documents full of extra spaces and blank lines (normalize: whitespace).

messages.content:
You are the customer service assistant of a B2B web shop. Answer only from the context.

Context:

--- Document 1 ---
Returns policy



Customers   can return   standard products within 30 days.   



Custom-made products   cannot be returned.





--- Document 2 ---
Warranty



   The warranty period is 24 months   from delivery.    


Spare parts have a 12-month warranty.   






--- Document 3 ---
Shipping



Standard shipping takes   3 to 5 working days.



Express shipping   (1 to 2 days)   costs 25 EUR.   





--- Document 4 ---
Payment



   We accept invoice payment (30 days net)   for business customers.



   Credit card payment is available in the web shop.
Hi,   I bought   a spare part   8 months ago and it broke.   Is it still under warranty?
